title: Sign In and Sign Out
intro: Welcome to Hostel Asset Management. This video shows how to sign in and sign out.
steps: Sign out: button next to your name

title: Find Your Way Around
intro: This short video shows how to find your way around the app.
steps: Operations: In Register and Out Register
On a phone: the bottom bar

title: Add a Foundation
intro: In this video, you will learn how to add a Foundation. Every Foundation gets its own Central Warehouse automatically.
steps: Edit: click the blue pencil button

title: Add a Unit
intro: In this video, you will learn how to add a Unit. A unit is a hostel or a college under a Foundation.
steps: Choose Unit Type: Hostel or College
Saved — edit with the blue pencil button

title: Add a Category
intro: In this video, you will learn how to add a Category, and how to mark it for warranty.
steps: Tick Warranty Applicable (if items have a warranty)

title: Add a Measuring Unit
intro: In this video, you will learn how to add a Measuring Unit, such as Nos, Sets or Kg.
steps: Click Add Measuring Unit to save

title: Add a Damage Destination
intro: In this video, you will learn how to add a Damage Destination. This is where damaged items are sent, such as a scrap dealer.

title: Add an Item
intro: In this video, you will learn how to add an Item. Items are the assets you count, like beds, fans and chairs.

title: Add a User
intro: In this video, you will learn how to add a User and choose their role.
steps: Set a Password, then Add User
Saved — they can sign in now

title: Add a Purchase
intro: In this video, you will learn how to enter a purchase in the In Register.

title: Add Opening Stock
intro: In this video, you will learn how to enter opening stock, the items a unit already has when you start.
steps: Choose the Unit and the Item
Enter Quantity and As Of Date
Click Add Stock — once per item per unit

title: Add a Warranty Item
intro: In this video, you will learn how to enter an item that has a warranty, like a fan or a generator.
steps: Choose the Item — Quantity is fixed at 1
Add Stock — warranty is added automatically

title: Bulk Upload Opening Stock
intro: In this video, you will learn how to load opening stock for many items at once from an Excel file.
steps: Fill one row per Unit and Item, then save

title: Transfer Items
intro: In this video, you will learn how to transfer items from the Central Warehouse to a unit. The same steps work between any two units or warehouses.
steps: Waiting for the receiver to update Received Qty

title: Issue a Warranty Item
intro: In this video, you will learn how to issue an item that has a warranty, by choosing its serial number.
steps: Serial No. shown on the entry

title: Send for Repair
intro: In this video, you will learn how to send items for repair.

title: Mark Items Damaged
intro: In this video, you will learn how to report damaged items.
steps: Sent To After Damage, and Notes

title: Cancel a Waiting Entry
intro: In this video, you will learn how to cancel a transfer or damage report that is still waiting.

title: Receive a Transfer
intro: In this video, you will learn how the receiving unit updates the quantity that arrived in a transfer.
steps: Click the blue tick (Update Received Qty)

title: Approve or Reject Damage
intro: In this video, you will learn how to approve or reject a damage report.

title: Record a Repair Return
intro: In this video, you will learn how to record items coming back from repair.

title: Inventory and Item History
intro: In this video, you will learn how to read the Inventory and an item's history.
steps: Click an item for its history

title: Warranties
intro: In this video, you will learn how to check warranties.
steps: Edit with the blue pencil button

title: Telegram Settings
intro: In this video, you will learn how to connect Telegram notifications. This is for the Admin.
steps: Tick Send, add Bot Token and Main Group Chat ID
Save Settings, then Send a Test
